title: calendars-server: opt-in conditional
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9b. Crates: jmap-calendars-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §7; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_calendars_conditional attaching SetSupport to every registered calendars /set; register_calendars_handlers unchanged; memory on ScopedState + ConditionalBackend; Atomic final-state checks: single default Calendar where specified, overQuota/caps, cascades. Acceptance: precondition, atomic rollback, final-state quota/cap tests; conditional_ready() after opt-in; public-api additions only.
